title: McDonald's Plans $8.5 Billion Restaurant Overhaul
paragraphs: McDonald's announced on September 23 that it plans to spend $8.5 billion over the next decade modernizing its restaurants around the world. The company says it wants to make kitchens more efficient, automate routine tasks and give customers more reasons to visit.

The plans include better kitchen layouts, larger play areas and lockers for delivery orders. Coffee preparation areas will be made more visible to customers. McDonald's also plans to expand its use of scales that help staff check orders for accuracy, from 10,000 restaurants today to 20,000 by 2028.

Technology is another focus. A system called ArchIQ uses AI to improve order accuracy and automate tasks such as inventory management and staff scheduling. Meanwhile, Archy, an AI system for drive-thru orders, can now take orders in English and Spanish with 90% accuracy.

Chief Financial Officer Ian Borden said Archy could eventually save a typical restaurant at least 50 hours of work each week. He said McDonald's does not intend to reduce staffing. Instead, employees could spend more time helping customers or preparing food.

The menu is changing too. McDonald's says its hand-breaded chicken has improved sales and customer ratings at restaurants where it has been introduced. Already available at 10,000 locations in Asia and a few near Chicago, it will be tested in more US markets and Ireland next year.

The company also plans to introduce grilled chicken sandwiches and wraps, as well as test products such as egg bites and bowls. These could appeal to customers looking for more protein or different portion sizes. According to McDonald's research, 60 million Americans are actively trying to eat more protein.
"This is an opportunity. We need to keep giving them more reasons to make McDonald’s their first choice," said Skye Anderson, president of McDonald's USA.
Investors appeared less enthusiastic about the cost of the overhaul: McDonald's shares fell nearly 5% on the day of the announcement.
